minor.issue: Origin and X-Forwarded-Host client-set headers are rewritten/stripped by the preview k8s ingress before reaching backend, so those two prod-detection paths cannot be exercised from outside the cluster. Code inspection (server.py:397-407) shows all four sources (host/origin/x-forwarded-host/referer) are checked correctly, and the Referer path was verified working. No fix required — flagged for awareness.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: ReferenceError 'dashboard is not defined' — code read `dashboard?.stats?.level_commissions` / `dashboard?.stats?.current_stage_commission` but the state variable is named `stats` (see line 23 `setStats(data.stats)`). This crashed the entire /dashboard page with an Uncaught runtime error, blocking THE PRIMARY iteration-12 acceptance criterion (Stage 1 commission = ₹1,200). Replaced with `stats?.level_commissions` / `stats?.current_stage_commission`.

action_items: Confirm the Dashboard.jsx fix (variable rename dashboard?.stats → stats) is acceptable — it was a straightforward typo blocking the whole page.

Optional: strip the still-present ₹7,200 references from /site/settings.terms_content (section 2 + section 3) — the terms document was not updated to the new joining fee of ₹7,499. Not part of the iteration 12 acceptance list but likely a follow-up.

Optional hardening: /admin/coupons POST accepts `used_count` but ignores it. Consider surfacing an error when a non-zero used_count is sent, or better — provide an admin PUT path that ALLOWS bumping used_count (currently PUT also strips it). Testing 'usage limit reached' required a direct mongo write.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2296 lines (was 2140 in iter11) — well past the 700-line guideline. Split into routers before more features land.
Dashboard.jsx variable naming inconsistency (dashboard vs stats) already crashed the page once — audit other pages for similar stale-refactor leftovers.

/admin/coupons PUT strips used_count silently. Fine for accidental override protection, but there is no supported admin path to reset a bad used_count value. Consider a dedicated /admin/coupons/{id}/reset-usage endpoint.

/auth/otp/send prod-detection uses substring `in` on 4 request-header sources — good defense-in-depth, but consider using exact host comparison after stripping scheme/port to avoid a domain like 'notevergroemart.com.example' from ever slipping through (currently the check is `'evergroemart.com' in host`).

rca of the issue: Dashboard runtime crash — variable naming refactor from `dashboard.stats.*` to a top-level `stats` state was incomplete: lines 55-56 still referenced the removed `dashboard` identifier. React rendered the component, JS hit `dashboard?.stats?.level_commissions`, ReferenceError bubbled to the ErrorBoundary and the entire page rendered blank with 'Uncaught runtime errors'. Reproduction: login as any joined user → navigate to /dashboard → see the 'dashboard is not defined' overlay. Fix: replace `dashboard?.stats?.level_commissions` with `stats?.level_commissions` and `dashboard?.stats?.current_stage_commission` with `stats?.current_stage_commission`. Verified post-fix: STAGE COMMISSION card renders ₹1,200 for Stage 1 user EG000043.
